name: 86426 · Fort Mohave, AZ
findings: ZIP 86426 (Fort Mohave) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 86426 (Fort Mohave) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
